adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts` now calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`, and the `Calendar` type definition was updated to require `(event, credentialId)` (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts). However, at least two concrete implementers in this diff still define `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` without the new parameter (e.g., `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` and `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`). In JS/TS, extra call arguments are ignored at runtime, so this creates an interface/behavior inconsistency (the caller passes `credential.id` but those implementations cannot use it). That said, the diff does not prove this causes incorrect behavior (those integrations may not need `credentialId`), so calling it a P1 runtime defect is not verifiable from the diff alone.
